How to get the raw data CLAUDE: Only a single processed supplementary file (GSE117556_non-normalized.csv.gz, probe-level non-normalized intensities) is deposited on the GEO series page; no CEL/IDAT scan files are attached, so the original Illumina HT-12 WG-DASL bead-level raw data cannot be obtained from GEO.

Download processed counts/log2CPM from GEO series GSE125966, and use SRA Toolkit prefetch/fasterq-dump on the SRR run accessions under BioProject PRJNA518119 (SRP183071) to obtain raw FASTQ for all 553 GOYA trial RNA-seq samples; spot-checked SRX5316605/SRR8512989 shows no dbGaP/controlled-access restriction notice.
Download GSE31312_RAW.tar from the GEO series supplementary files - it contains the original Affymetrix CEL files for all samples (PMID 22437443, 498 de novo DLBCL FFPE cases, GPL570).

Download GSE127462_RAW.tar from the GEO series page - contains original Affymetrix U133 Plus 2.0 CEL files (302 samples, 'High-throughput tissue dissection and cell purification with digital cytometry' [Affymetrix] study, source for CIBERSORTx reference profiles).
Download GSE10846_RAW.tar from the GEO series supplementary files - contains original Affymetrix CEL/TXT files for the 420-sample R-CHOP vs CHOP DLBCL cohort (GPL570).
Download GSE87371_RAW.tar from the GEO series supplementary files - contains original Affymetrix U133 Plus 2.0 CEL files for the 223 GCB/ABC/PMBL DLBCL subtype cohort (GPL570).

Not in GEO - download the raw Affymetrix CEL files directly from the NCI/LLMPP companion website for Dave et al., NEJM 2004 (351:2159-2169): '.CEL files for FL cases (U133A) arrays' (674 Mb) and '.CEL files for FL cases (U133B) arrays' (649 Mb) at https://llmpp.ccr.cancer.gov/FL/, along with a processed tab-delimited expression matrix and clinical data file on the same page.

Download GSE11318_RAW.tar from the GEO series supplementary files - contains original CEL/TXT raw files for the 406-sample cohort across two platforms (GPL570 Affymetrix U133 Plus 2.0 and GPL6400 NimbleGen tiling array).

Download raw supplementary files from both linked GEO series: GSE66166 (138 samples: GSE66166_RAW.tar + GSE66166_non-normalized_data.txt.gz) at https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE66166 and GSE119214 (137 samples: GSE119214_RAW.tar + non-normalized data) at https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE119214, both Illumina HumanHT-12 WG-DASL V4 (GPL13938) FL cohorts underlying the Pastore et al. m7-FLIPI risk model papers.
Download GSE93261_RAW.tar from the GEO series page - contains original Affymetrix U133 Plus 2.0 CEL files for the 149-sample PRIMA-trial follicular lymphoma cohort (GPL570).

Download GSE32918_RAW.tar from the GEO series supplementary files (Illumina HumanRef-8 WG-DASL v3 raw/non-normalized bead-level data for 172 FFPE DLBCL biopsies); GSE32918_non-normalized.txt.gz is also provided.

GSE22898 is a SuperSeries ('Deep Sequencing of the Small RNA Transcriptome of Normal and Malignant Human B cells'); the mRNA-array sub-series actually matching this cohort's platform (GPL6244, Affymetrix Human Gene 1.0 ST, FF, 100+ DLBCL samples) is GSE22895 — download GSE22895_RAW.tar (CEL files) or GSE22898_RAW.tar directly.

Raw RNA-seq FASTQ files are on SRA under BioProject PRJNA622950 / SRA study SRP255154 (matches the srx/samn accessions in the annotation, e.g. SRX8052951 etc.); use SRA Toolkit prefetch/fasterq-dump on the SRR run accessions listed for these SRX/BioSample IDs, or browse via https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Traces/study/?acc=PRJNA622950.
Download GSE103944_RAW.tar (CEL files, Affymetrix HG-U133A / GPL96) from the GEO series supplementary files.
Download GSE53820_RAW.tar (raw CEL files, Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0 / GPL570) from the GEO series supplementary files.
Download GSE34171_RAW.tar (8.6 GB, CEL files across HG-U133A/B, HG-U133 Plus 2.0, and SNP6.0 platforms) plus clinical_info.txt.gz/outcome_data.txt.gz from the GEO series supplementary files.
Download GSE37088_RAW.tar (raw CEL files, Affymetrix HG-U133A / GPL96) from the GEO series supplementary files.
Download GSE23501_RAW.tar (raw CEL files, Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0 / GPL570) from the GEO series supplementary files.
Download GSE55267_RAW.tar (raw CEL files, Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0 / GPL570) from the GEO series supplementary files.
Download GSE19246_RAW.tar (raw CEL files, Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0 / GPL570) from the GEO series supplementary files.
Download GSE56313_RAW.tar (raw CEL files, Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0 / GPL570) from the GEO series supplementary files.
Download GSE93984_RAW.tar (raw CEL files, Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0 / GPL570) from the GEO series supplementary files.

Download the individual raw Affymetrix HG-U133A CEL files (e.g. KL_B8_U133A.CEL, KL_B17_U133A.CEL, ...) directly from the E-TABM-346 study page on BioStudies/ArrayExpress; a consolidated processed-data file is also provided separately.

GEO series GSE154583 hosts only processed/normalized count matrices; download raw FASTQ reads from linked SRA project PRJNA646728 / SRP272262 (43 samples) via the SRA Run Selector or prefetch/fasterq-dump.
Download GSE64555_RAW.tar (177.9 MB) from the GEO series supplementary files, which contains raw Affymetrix CEL/CHP files for all 40 samples.
Download the GEO series RAW.tar (82.1 Mb) containing raw CEL files for all 40 samples (Affymetrix HT HG-U133+ PM Array Plate, GPL13158).
Download GSE148070_RAW.tar (914.2 Mb) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL/CHP files for all 40 FL lymph node biopsies (Affymetrix HTA 2.0, GPL17586).
Download GSE13029_RAW.tar (278.8 Mb) from the GEO series, containing raw Agilent two-color microarray files for the follicular lymphoma tissue samples.
Download GSE68878_RAW.tar (905.7 Mb) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL files for all 38 samples (Affymetrix Human Exon 1.0 ST Array, GPL20188).
Download GSE36907_RAW.tar (278.6 MB) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL files (both GPL570 and GPL6244 subsets).
Download the GEO series RAW.tar (842.1 Mb) containing raw CEL files for all 35 samples (Affymetrix Human Exon 1.0 ST Array, GPL23541).
Download GSE56314_RAW.tar (154.4 MB) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL files for all 33 samples (GPL570).
Download GSE69033_RAW.tar (763.2 Mb) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL files for all 30 samples (Affymetrix Human Exon 1.0 ST Array, GPL20188).

GEO series supplementary files provide only processed bigWig tracks; download raw RNA-seq FASTQ/SRA runs from linked BioProject PRJNA263567 / SRA study SRP048820 (Illumina HiSeq 2000) via SRA Run Selector.
Download GSE107683_RAW.tar (121.5 Mb) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL files for all 27 samples (GPL570).

GSE153439 is a SuperSeries ('The Tumor Microenvironment and Inflammation Influence toxicity in patients with Large B Cell Lymphoma Treated with Axicabtagene Ciloleucel') with 61 samples; download the RNA-seq SubSeries GSE153437 raw FASTQ via linked SRA BioProject PRJNA642653, and/or raw NanoString RCC files (GSE153438 / GSE153439_RAW.tar) for the NanoString arm.
Download GSE12453_RAW.tar from the GEO series page (Supplementary file section), which contains all Affymetrix HG-U133_Plus_2 (GPL570) CEL files for the 25 samples; no registration required.
Download GSE156751_RAW.tar from the GEO series page, which contains raw Agilent (GPL17077) scan TXT files for naive B cell/memory B cell/plasmablast samples; no registration required.
Download GSE89282_RAW.tar from the GEO series page, containing Affymetrix Human Gene 2.0 ST (GPL16686) CEL files for B cell subsets from terminal ileum and spleen; no registration required.

Download the 24 individual raw Agilent scan TXT files (FL01.txt-FL42.txt) plus the combined MAGE-TAB file from the E-MEXP-2305 BioStudies/ArrayExpress page; freely accessible, no registration required.
Download GSE22886_RAW.tar from the GEO series page, containing Affymetrix HG-U133A/HG-U133B (GPL96/GPL97) CEL files for resting and activated human immune cell subsets; no registration required.
Download GSE12195_RAW.tar from the GEO series page, containing Affymetrix HG-U133_Plus_2 (GPL570) CEL files; no registration required.

Download GSE64028_RAW.tar from the GEO series page, containing Affymetrix HG-U133_Plus_2 (GPL570) CEL files for healthy human peripheral blood B cell subsets; no registration required.
GEO hosts only a processed TPM file (GSE111310_ipa_tpm.txt.gz); download raw FASTQ via linked SRA/BioProject PRJNA436569 (SRA: SRP133767) using SRA Run Selector or sra-tools.

GEO hosts only a processed TPM file (GSE139833_n_gc_m_lz_dz_tpm_grch38.txt.gz); download raw FASTQ via linked SRA/BioProject PRJNA587124 (SRA: SRP227968) using SRA Run Selector or sra-tools. GEO record explicitly states 'Raw data are available in SRA.'
Download GSE141005_RAW.tar from the GEO series page, containing Affymetrix Human Gene 2.0 ST (GPL16686) CEL files; no registration required.
Download GSE149089_RAW.tar from the GEO series supplementary files section, which contains the raw Affymetrix Clariom D (.CEL) files for all 15 samples; no registration required.
Download GSE17186_RAW.tar (63.8 Mb) from the GEO series page; contains raw HG-U133 Plus 2.0 CEL files for all 14 samples.
Download GSE12845_RAW.tar (36.6 Mb) from the GEO series page; contains raw HG-U133A (GPL96) CEL files for all 14 samples.
Download GSE136249_RAW.tar (54.1 Mb) from the GEO series page; contains raw HG-U133 Plus 2.0 CEL files for all 12 samples.
Download GSE12366_RAW.tar (90.7 Mb) from the GEO series page; contains raw HG-U133 Plus 2.0 CEL files for all 12 samples.
Download GSE136248_RAW.tar (54.7 Mb) from the GEO series page; contains raw HG-U133 Plus 2.0 CEL files for all 12 samples.

GEO series GSE142334 supplies only an htseq processed-counts matrix; raw FASTQ for the 12 samples (6 paired FL/transformed-FL) must be pulled from the linked SRA BioProject PRJNA596663 (SRP238213) via SRA Toolkit / SRA Run Selector - fully open access, no application needed.

GEO series GSE92387 supplies only processed TXT count files; raw FASTQ for the 24 samples must be pulled from the linked SRA BioProject PRJNA357448 (SRP095109) via SRA Toolkit / SRA Run Selector - open access.
Download GSE51528_RAW.tar (946.3 Mb) from the GEO series page; contains raw HuGene-1_0-st (GPL6244) CEL files.
Download GSE46261_RAW.tar (966.3 Mb) from the GEO series page; contains raw Human Gene 1.0 ST (GPL17047) CEL files.

Download via the BioStudies/ArrayExpress FTP/HTTP mirror (ftp://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/fire/E-MTAB-/088/E-MTAB-6088/); the study record lists a distinct 'raw-data' file section (Affymetrix Gene ST CEL files) alongside 'processed-data', all openly downloadable without registration.

GEO series GSE120795 supplies only a processed counts matrix (GSE120795_total_norms_raw_counts.tsv.gz); raw FASTQ for the samples must be pulled from the linked SRA BioProject PRJNA494560 (SRP163252) via SRA Toolkit / SRA Run Selector - open access.
Fetch raw FASTQ via SRA Toolkit (prefetch/fasterq-dump) or ENA using BioProject PRJNA373954 / SRA study SRP100394 (29 runs: WES + RNA-seq); fully public, no controlled-access application needed.

Download GSE144089_RAW.tar (27.7 Mb) from the GEO series page; contains the per-sample raw Agilent Feature Extraction TXT files (Agilent's native raw-intensity format, the two-color-array equivalent of a CEL file) for the Agilent-039494 SurePrint G3 array (GPL17077).

GEO series GSE110669 supplies only processed text count files; raw FASTQ for the 9 samples must be pulled from the linked SRA BioProject PRJNA434224 (SRP132924) via SRA Toolkit / SRA Run Selector - open access.

GEO series GSE115655 (16 samples, human bone-marrow/tonsil B-cell subsets incl. normal proB) only supplies a processed TMM-cpm matrix (GSE115655_BCells.TMM.cpm.txt.gz) as its supplementary file, but raw FASTQ reads for the same samples are deposited under linked SRA project SRP150315 / BioProject PRJNA475684; download runs via the SRA Run Selector linked from the GEO page or `prefetch`/`fasterq-dump`.

Download GSE15271_RAW.tar (41.2 MB) from the GEO series supplementary files link, which contains raw Affymetrix CEL files for the 8 CXCR4+/CXCR4- (centroblast/centrocyte) tonsil B-cell samples on GPL570.

GEO series GSE45982 (61 samples; RNA-seq + ChIP-seq across GPL10999/GPL11154/GPL13112) supplies only processed BED/WIG/TXT files as supplementary data; raw FASTQ reads are available openly (no access restriction) via linked SRA project SRP021509 through the SRA Run Selector or ENA.
Download GSE13411_RAW.tar (24.4 MB) from the GEO series supplementary files section, containing raw Affymetrix HG-U133A CEL files for the 8 splenic B-cell subset samples (GPL96).
Download the GSE38697_RAW.tar (38.0 MB) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL files for 8 human tonsil germinal-center light-zone/dark-zone B-cell samples (GPL570).

Fetch raw FASTQ files for the ~31 ocular adnexal B-cell lymphoma RNA-seq samples via the SRA Run Selector for SRP312586 (or the equivalent ENA project), using `prefetch`/`fasterq-dump` or ENA's direct FASTQ download links; data is public (released Aug 2022).

Download GSE55267_RAW.tar (290 MB) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL files for the full 69-sample series (31 FL tumors + centroblast/centrocyte/naive B-cell controls on GPL570); our cohort likely uses the 6 normal control samples.

Download GSE19599_RAW.tar (67.8 MB) from the GEO series supplementary files, containing raw CEL files for the 16 flow-sorted normal hematopoietic subpopulation samples (GPL570); our cohort uses 6 of these.

Download the raw CEL files (221.1 MB TAR) from the GEO series supplementary files for GSE61912 ('Enhancer Sequence Variants...(array)' arm); platform GPL10739 (Affymetrix Human Gene 1.0 ST) uses CEL files, not IDAT - our cohort likely uses a subset of the 14 normal B-cell control samples (peripheral blood B cells / cord blood).

GEO series GSE84022 (8 samples: naive and germinal-center B cells, Hi-C + RNA-seq) supplies only processed SIF/BED files as GEO supplementary data; raw FASTQ reads (RNA-seq and Hi-C) are openly downloadable via linked SRA project SRP077918 / BioProject PRJNA327832 through SRA Run Selector or ENA.

GEO series GSE119103 (90 samples total; ChIP-seq/RNA-seq/DNAme in CLL) provides raw BigWig tracks and a processed counts matrix as GEO supplementary files; true raw FASTQ reads are openly downloadable (no access restriction) via linked SRA project SRP158943 through SRA Run Selector or ENA.
